title: It may be
instructions: In Proven&#231;ale . --Clean, prepare, and cut the fish in pieces about two inches long; put about three pounds of it in a saucepan, with a pint of claret; six stalks of parsley, a small onion, a clove of garlic, and six mushrooms, all chopped fine; boil till done, when add four ounces of butter, and two of flour, well kneaded together; boil three minutes longer, and serve warm.
Another way, or &#224; la Chambord. --Stuff the fish with sausage-meat, envelop it in a towel, boil, and serve it with a tomato-sauce.
The same with Sorrel . --Broil the fish, and serve it on a
pur&#233;e of sorrel or of spinach.
